## 🌟 What Makes a Great Showcase

### 📸 Visual Appeal
- 🖼️ **High-quality screenshots** - Show off that crisp theme!
- 🎨 **Multiple angles** - Desktop, apps, settings menu
- 🌓 **Both variants** - Light and dark if you use both
- 🧹 **Clean desktop** - Tidy up before screenshotting

### 📝 Details to Share

| Category | What to Include |
|----------|-----------------|
| **🖥️ Desktop Environment** | GNOME, Cinnamon, XFCE, MATE, Budgie |
| **🐧 Distro** | Ubuntu, Fedora, Arch, etc. |
| **🎨 Icon Theme** | Papirus, Tela, Nordic, etc. |
| **🖼️ Wallpaper** | Link or describe |
| **🔧 Customizations** | CSS tweaks, configs, extensions |

## 📸 Screenshot Tips

### 🎨 For Best Results

1. **📐 Resolution** - Use at least 1920x1080
2. **🧹 Clean up** - Hide personal files and minimize windows
3. **🎭 Consistency** - Show multiple apps to demonstrate the theme
4. **🌓 Variants** - Capture both light and dark themes
5. **📱 Multiple shots** - Show overview, settings, terminal, etc.

### 🖼️ Image Hosting

Need to upload screenshots?
- GitHub's native upload (drag & drop)
- [Imgur](https://imgur.com)
- [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/PhantomNimbi/Hentai-Senpai-GTK-Theme/issues) (upload there, paste link here)
